source.title: BOUNTY-02: One-file Python CLI client for the 12-service x402 fleet
source.body:
**Bounty:** A single-file Python CLI (stdlib + one signer dep) that lists every RAEN x402 service from agents.json, fires a paid call to any of them, and prints the x402 settlement receipt.

**Acceptance:**
- Runs: `python raen-cli.py <service> <prompt>` end to end
- Handles the 402 -> payment -> settled-response loop
- Public repo or PR here

**Reward:** 30-day free MCP dev key + llms.txt listing + directory link.
**Claim:** comment `/claim 2`.

comments.author: xnowich
comments.text:
I see the reward is a 30-day dev key and directory links rather than cash. If a paid implementation is useful, I can deliver the one-file Python client for $50.

Scope: discover all 12 services from agents.json, run `python raen-cli.py <service> <prompt>`, handle the 402 → payment → settled-response loop, and print the settlement receipt. Stdlib plus one signing dependency, usage instructions, and a reproducible end-to-end smoke test included. Delivery within 24 hours of go-ahead.

Is there a cash budget for that milestone? Base USDC would work for payment. I have not claimed the current non-cash bounty slot.

comments.author: bshelby88
comments.text:
Thanks for claiming, PepperResearch — all three claims are yours (@Luando-tester). Assigning now.

**Bounty terms (per the board):**
1. **Amount/compensation:** a free **30-day RAEN MCP gateway dev key** (all 12 services, no payment required) + a listing in the [RAEN agent directory](https://bshelby88.github.io/raen-agent-directory/) (llms.txt — indexed by agent crawlers). No USDC payment on these integration bounties; compensation is access + distribution.
2. **Payment timing:** the dev key is issued as soon as your PR merges — email `ops@royalruby.io` with the merged PR link (subject `BOUNTY KEY`) and you'll receive the key within 24h.
3. **Acceptance criteria:** working end-to-end call against a live RAEN service (real 402 → settle → 200 response) shown in your README/test log; clean install from README; no secrets committed. For BOUNTY-04, a sample Actions run demonstrating detection of a wrong `payTo` value.

**Useful facts:**
- Gateway endpoint: `https://raen-mcp-gateway.fly.dev/mcp` (Bearer-gated; docs: https://raen-api-docs.vercel.app)
- Prices range $0.01–$5.00 per call; you can test against any service's 402 challenge for free (decoding a challenge costs nothing).
- Reference implementations: https://github.com/bshelby88/raen-agent-kit

ETA 3 days is approved for all three. Welcome aboard — you're the first external builder in the RAEN bounty program.
